title: 第23章 热闹的老宅
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: 时值一九六零年，到处都是吃不饱饭的人。每个人都是面黄肌瘦，平日里能喝上一碗稀薄的野菜糊糊已是难得。此刻，老宅院子很热闹。大哥辰建设、二哥辰建国、三哥辰建军、四哥辰建民，全都聚在这里帮忙干活。年迈的爷奶坐在石凳上指挥着，脸上的笑容就没停过。“好家伙，这野猪可真不小！”二哥辰建国操着刀，手法娴熟地刮着猪毛，额头上沁出细密的汗珠。三哥辰建军在一旁打下手，嘿嘿笑道：“得亏辰楠有本事，这么大个家伙，居然一个人给弄回来了。”辰楠拔下野猪头颅上的砍柴刀，就站在一旁看着堂哥们干活。他的脸色依旧有些苍白，吃的东西没营养以及被野猪冲撞，让这个十八岁出头的小伙子瘦得颧骨突出，但眼睛却格外明亮。“辰楠你没事吧？”“我这看你脸色有些白。”“城里人肤色白些很正常啊。”“乡下人整天面朝黄土背朝天，肯定没城里人白。”几个堂哥调侃着，得知这野猪是捡来的，倒也不担心辰楠会受伤。这野猪还很新鲜，刚死不超过半个小时，唯一可惜的是猪血都流干了，那血也是可以吃的。不过这也是好事，野猪不放血，腥味会很重。辰楠对几个堂哥的调侃并不在意。最大的堂哥年纪直逼老爸，最小年纪的堂哥都比他大三岁。乡下人成家早，四哥在十八岁的时候就已经娶媳妇，媳妇都给他生了两个娃。可以说他小时候就是在村里跟着几个堂哥一起长大的，后来老爸在城里有了工作他才被接进城。“大哥，二哥，三哥，四哥，你们怎么不把嫂子孩子们都叫来帮忙？”辰建设立即摇摇头：“他们在家里就行，这点活都不够我们兄弟四人干的。”“就是啊，这点活儿不多，我们几个人就可以搞定。”辰建国也摇头拒绝。他们几个人过来帮忙还好，若是所有人都过来，那不叫帮忙，那纯粹就是带着一张嘴过来白吃的。他们四人加上各自的媳妇与孩子，人数都二十二口人！他们家都是四个孩子，也就老四才两个孩子，否则还不止二十二个人。那么多人一起过来吃肉，这也太不好意思了。奶奶凑热闹走到野猪跟前，伸出枯瘦的手摸了摸：“这有多少斤肉……”“奶，您坐着去，这儿脏。”四哥辰建民连忙扶住老太太，“估摸着得有一百二三十斤呢！”“那么多肉在这里，你确定不喊他们来一起吃点？”奶奶知道小楠大气，不在意这个，但他的四个哥哥们却是不好意思。毕竟这肉腌制起来可以吃很久，一般人都不会往外送。“这……”几兄弟相视一眼，他们也想喊媳妇孩子来吃一顿，他们没本事，好久没让家里人吃顿肉了。可这一喊的话，人数实在是太多了。如果所有人都过来一起吃的话，估计能吃半头野猪。还不等他们说些什么，辰楠就抬手打断了他们。“大妹你过来一下。”辰楠对着妹妹们喊话。正在烧水的招娣闻言，放下柴火小跑过来，“哥哥，你叫我干嘛？”“我们家好久没这么热闹过，今日难得的机会。”“你去把嫂子跟侄儿们都喊过来吃杀猪宴。”“就等哥哥这句话了。”招娣很是高兴，她可喜欢跟侄儿们玩了。谁知道堂哥们都不喊他们过来，她小跑出了院子。辰建设几兄弟对视一眼笑了笑，辰楠的变化有些大，比以前大气好说话了。十几分钟后。老宅里更热闹了。几个嫂子带着一群孩子们到来。没错，就是一群，十几个孩子。也就这老宅在村边皮没什么人。若是在村子中间，肯定会引来许多人围观。当他们看到院子里那被剃毛的野猪时，顿时就相信了招娣的话。招娣跟她们说过来吃杀猪宴，她们还不信，这时候哪来的野猪啊。但招娣说得很认真，让她们把孩子都带上。持着怀疑的态度来到老宅，被眼前一幕看呆。“哇，好大的野猪啊！”“肉肉，好多肉肉！”“这下有口福了。”“辰楠叔的运气也太好了，这都能捡到野猪啊！”一群孩子叽叽喳喳说着不停，一整头野猪就在眼前，想想就流口水。嫂子们也是一脸激动，她们好久没吃肉了。没想到自家男人都在帮忙处理野猪了呢。“嫂子侄儿们都到了，那就帮忙搭把手，等下一起吃杀猪宴，能吃多少就吃多少，大家尽情的吃！”院子里众人一听这话，顿时都忍不住咽了咽口水。在这饭都吃不饱的年月，突然得到一头野猪，这简直就是老天爷赏饭吃。孩子们更是围在四周，眼睛瞪得溜圆，生怕一眨眼这肥美的野猪就会消失似的。“都别愣着了，赶紧收拾利索。”爷爷发话了，虽然努力保持着家长的威严，但声音里也透着压抑不住的兴奋。嫂子们加入，帮忙剃毛，清理肠子，男人们则合力将野猪分割。夕阳下，猪肉泛着诱人的光泽，肥瘦相间，看得人直咽口水。院里的小孩们最兴奋，围在案板旁边，叽叽喳喳地闲聊。“野猪肉好吃吗？”“肉肯定好吃啊！”“肉是什么味的？”“好久没吃肉，不记得了。”“以后我们也上山捡野猪。”“野猪哪有那么好捡，小心去了回不来。”“村里的猎人都不一定打得到野猪。”辰楠看着一群小孩子笑了笑没说话。真是一群小可怜，连肉是什么味道的都不记得了。上山“捡”野猪没那么简单，这次纯属是运气好。辰楠告诫了他们一番，没事别上山，若是遇到野猪，能不能活着回来都是个未知数。至于“捡”野猪，还是等他把这具身体养好了再考虑吧。无意中遇到一头野猪就被撞飞差点受伤。若是野猪的体积再大点，他或许就不能站在这里与众人谈笑风生。
content_en: It was 1960, and people everywhere were hungry.Everyone is sallow and thin, and it is rare to have a bowl of thin wild vegetable paste on weekdays.At this moment, the courtyard of the old house is very lively.The eldest brother Chen Jianshe, the second brother Chen Jianguo, the third brother Chen Jianjun, and the fourth brother Chen Jianmin all gathered here to help with the work.The elderly grandma sat on the stone bench and gave instructions, with a smile on her face that never stopped."Good guy, this wild boar is really big!" The second brother Chen Jianguo used a knife to shave the pig's hair skillfully, and beads of sweat appeared on his forehead.The third brother, Chen Jianjun, was on the sidelines and said with a smile: "Thanks to Chen Nan's ability, I managed to get such a big guy back by myself." Chen Nan pulled out the woodcutter from the wild boar's head and stood aside to watch his cousins ​​work.His face was still a little pale. The food he ate was not nutritious and he was charged by a wild boar, which made this young man in his early eighteen years so thin that his cheekbones protruded, but his eyes were exceptionally bright."Chen Nan, are you okay?" "I see you look a little pale." "It's normal for city people to have fairer skin." "Country people face the loess all day long, and their backs are definitely not as white as city people." Several cousins ​​joked, knowing that the wild boar was picked up, so they were not worried that Chen Nan would be injured.The wild boar was still very fresh and had been dead for less than half an hour. The only pity was that all the pig's blood had dried up, and that blood could also be eaten.But this is also a good thing. If the wild boar does not bleed, the smell will be very strong.Chen Nan didn't care about the teasing of several cousins.The oldest cousin is as old as his father, and the youngest cousin is three years older than him.Country people get married early. The fourth brother married a wife when he was eighteen years old, and she gave birth to two children for him.It can be said that when he was a child, he grew up with several cousins ​​in the village. Later, when his father got a job in the city, he was taken to the city."Eldest brother, second brother, third brother, fourth brother, why don't you call your sister-in-law and children to help?" Chen Jianguo immediately shook his head: "They can do it at home. This is not enough work for the four of us brothers." "That's right, this is not a lot of work, just a few of us can handle it." Chen Jianguo also shook his head and refused.It's okay that a few of them came to help. If everyone came over, it wouldn't be called helping. It would just be a waste of money.The four of them, plus their respective wives and children, make a total of twenty-two people!Their family has four children, and only the fourth child has two children. Otherwise, there would be more than twenty-two people.It’s so embarrassing that so many people come here to eat meat together.Grandma joined in the fun and walked up to the wild boar, stretched out her skinny hand and touched it: "How many kilograms of meat is here..." "Milk, sit down, it's dirty here." Fourth brother Chen Jianmin quickly supported the old lady, "I guess it's 120 to 30 kilograms!" "There is so much meat here, are you sure you don't want them to come and eat some together?" Grandma knew that Xiaonan was grand and didn't care about this, but his four brothers were embarrassed.After all, this meat can be eaten for a long time after being marinated, and most people will not send it out."This..." The brothers looked at each other. They also wanted to call their wives and children to have a meal. They didn't have the ability. They hadn't let their family members eat meat for a long time.But if you shout this, there are too many people.If everyone came and ate together, they would probably eat half a wild boar.Before they could say anything, Chen Nan raised his hand to interrupt them."Sister, come here." Chen Nan called to the sisters.When Zhao Di, who was boiling water, heard this, she put down the firewood and trotted over, "Brother, what did you call me for?" "Our family hasn't been so lively for a long time. Today is a rare opportunity." "Go and call your sister-in-law and nephews over for a pig-killing feast." "Just wait for what brother says." Zhao Di was very happy. She really enjoyed playing with her nephews.Unexpectedly, her cousins ​​didn't call them over, so she trotted out of the yard.Chen Jianshe and the other brothers looked at each other and smiled. Chen Nan had changed a lot and was now more open-minded and talkative than before.Ten minutes later.The old house is even more lively.Several sisters-in-law arrived with a group of children.That's right, a group of more than a dozen children.It means that this old house is on the edge of the village and there are not many people there.If it were in the middle of the village, it would definitely attract many people to watch.When they saw the shaved wild boar in the yard, they immediately believed Zhaodi's words.Zhaodi told them to come over for a pig-killing feast, but they still didn't believe it. Where did the wild boar come from at this time?But Zhaodi was very serious and asked them to take their children with them.I came to the old house with a skeptical attitude and was stunned by the scene in front of me."Wow, what a big wild boar!" "Rourou, so much meat!" "This is a blessing." "Uncle Chen Nan is so lucky, he can even pick up a wild boar!" A group of children kept chattering, a whole wild boar was right in front of them, and they were drooling just thinking about it.The sisters-in-law were also very excited. They had not eaten meat for a long time.Unexpectedly, all the men in my family are helping to deal with the wild boar."Sister-in-law and nephews are all here, so help us. Let's have a pig-killing feast together later. We can eat as much as we can, and everyone can eat to their heart's content!" When everyone in the yard heard this, they couldn't help but swallow their saliva.In this age when there is not much to eat, suddenly getting a wild boar is like a gift from God.The children were even more crowded around, their eyes wide open, as if they were afraid that the plump wild boar would disappear in the blink of an eye."Don't be stunned, hurry up and clean up." Grandpa spoke. Although he tried hard to maintain the majesty of a parent, there was also uncontrollable excitement in his voice.The sisters-in-law joined in to help shave and clean the intestines, while the men worked together to carve up the wild boar.Under the setting sun, the pork has an attractive luster, with alternating fat and thin, making people salivate at the sight.The children in the courtyard were the most excited. They gathered around the chopping board and chatted."Is wild boar delicious?" "The meat must be delicious!" "What does the meat taste like?" "I haven't eaten meat for a long time, so I don't remember." "We will also go up the mountain to pick up wild boar in the future." "Wild boar is not that easy to pick up. Be careful and you won't come back." "The hunters in the village may not be able to hunt wild boar." Chen Nan looked at a group of children and smiled without saying anything.What a bunch of pathetic little people who can’t even remember what meat tastes like.It's not that easy to "pick up" wild boars on the mountain. This time it was just good luck.Chen Nan warned them not to go up the mountain if nothing happened. If they encountered a wild boar, it was unknown whether they could come back alive.As for "picking up" the wild boar, let's wait until he has taken care of the body before considering it.I accidentally encountered a wild boar and was knocked away and almost injured.If the wild boar were bigger, he might not be able to stand here and talk and laugh with everyone.
